title: Inflation Rate & Real Rate of Return Calculations
content: Nominal returns must be adjusted for inflation and taxes to measure true purchasing power growth: Real Return % ≈ ((1 + Nominal Return %) / (1 + Inflation Rate %)) - 1 - Tax Drag. For example, a 7% bank deposit with 6% inflation and 30% tax slab yields a NEGATIVE real rate of return (-1.1%), highlighting why long-term wealth requires equity index asset allocation.
